approach: JSON document per board. Each board row stores the full BoardData document (columns + cards) as a JSON string in a single `data` column. Chat history is a separate `chat_messages` table.
notes: SQLite is the local database. The file is created automatically on startup if missing.
One board per signed-in user for the MVP. Enforced by a UNIQUE constraint on boards.user_id.
Multiple users are supported by the schema for future use; only 'user'/'password' exists today.
The JSON document shape matches the frontend BoardData and what the AI (Part 9) will emit/consume.

tables.name: users
notes: MVP only has the hardcoded 'user' row; Part 6 seeds it and validates against this table.
password_hash is nullable for now (plaintext 'password' until a hashing decision is made).

tables.name: boards

constraints.notes: One board per user for MVP.

notes: data holds the whole BoardData JSON: { "columns": Column[], "cards": Record<string, Card> }.
Replaces the normalized columns/cards tables from the earlier origin/complete build.
Column order and card order are captured by the JSON arrays (Column.cardIds); no separate position columns.

tables.name: chat_messages
notes: Stores full conversation history per user/board for the AI chat (Parts 8-10).
role is 'user' or 'assistant'. content is the message text (assistant may also return a board update).
